description: This file defines a SOAP API server implementation for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, providing functions for user authentication, bean retrieval and updates, relationship management, and miscellaneous utility functions. It includes registration of SOAP methods such as login, logout, get_entry, set_entry, get_relationships, set_relationship, among others, and handles access control via ACLs and session validation.

classes.name: NoteSoap
classes.description: Class handling note attachments, including saving files and retrieving file contents.

methods.name: validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates that the session ID corresponds to a valid, current session and loads the current user.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specific access rights (read, write, etc.) to a module.

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Serializes a bean object into an array suitable for SOAP response.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of fields from a bean object.

methods.name: filter_return_list
methods.description: Filters a list of bean data to only include specific fields.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves vardef information on module fields for SOAP response.

methods.name: query_client_ip
methods.description: Gets the client's IP address from the request.

methods.name: get_linked_records
methods.description: Retrieves linked record IDs for a given module and record.

methods.name: set_productbundle_quote_relationship
methods.description: Sets a relationship between a quote and a product bundle.

methods.name: set_productbundle_product_relationship
methods.description: Sets a relationship between a product bundle and a product.

methods.name: decrypt_string
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted string, used for password handling.

methods.name: validate_user
methods.description: Validates a username and password combination.

methods.name: get_mailmerge_document
methods.description: Generates an HTML for a mail merge document based on specified fields and template file, returning base64-encoded HTML content.

methods.name: get_mailmerge_document2
methods.description: Similar to get_mailmerge_document but supports multi-record retrieval with more detailed processing and encoding.

methods.name: get_document_revision
methods.description: Retrieves a specific document revision, encodes its contents in base64, and returns it along with metadata.

methods.name: set_campaign_merge
methods.description: Logs a campaign mail merge event for tracking with campaign and target IDs.

methods.name: get_entries_count
methods.description: Returns the count of entries in a specified module, with optional filtering via query.

methods.name: set_entries_details
methods.description: Updates or creates multiple records in a specified module based on provided name-value lists.

methods.name: handle_set_entries
methods.description: Internal function that handles batch creation/update of beans with support for duplicate detection, applying field values, and ACL checks.
